Rhuce is presented as a campaign editor that can insert or remove missions and define new nonlinear mission sequences. The description also covers localized mission text, unit and weapon statistics, and interface elements.

The page states compatibility with game version 1.1, recommends using it alongside Spellforge, and mentions Ready2Play support. Its emphasis on campaign structure complements Spellforge’s mission editing. These features were documented from the publication, not tested by running the tool.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: rhmods.com tool page "Rhuce"; author field: Cyrdach, Molsga; no publication date, version, view count or comments displayed; footer "Copyright © 2026". Retrieved directly on 2026-09-09. No licence permitting reproduction is stated, so the description is summarised.

Content of the page:

- Name: Robin Hood Ultimate Campaign Editor, "Rhuce" for short; a modding tool that lets modders edit various aspects of the game.
- Main focus: modifying the campaign scenarios. Specifically it can insert a new mission into the existing storyline, remove base-game missions, or design an entirely new nonlinear sequence of missions.
- Mission presentation: edit the texts and overall appearance of a mission for its players. Supports the game's localisation system so texts for all languages can be edited at once.
- Units: edit the stats of particular units and their weapons; units and weapons can also be added or removed.
- Interface: view the game's interface elements and potentially define new ones.
- Compatibility: game version 1.1. Strongly recommended for use together with the Spellforge editor (linked). Also supports the Ready2Play Launcher (linked). The authors "bow to their creators".
- Distribution: "Get it on ModDB" link to `moddb.com/mods/rhuce-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood` (no direct download on rhmods.com).
- Not stated: file formats touched, version number, changelog, screenshots, save-game compatibility of edited campaigns.
